hacker-movement-accelerator-stock-stance.head: ed42ff95
hacker-movement-accelerator-stock-stance.scope: Actual 323/423 friendly recipient, exact costs and timers, sibling replacement, active stance-specific scales on owner and observers, and dismissal. Stock matched relative movement distances in normal, Spy Sneak and Belt. Also witnessed Hyper-Speed 12 in all three stances.

stats.source: The retained Hyper-Speed record sets normal +45, Sneak/Invisibility +12, all 600 s.
stats.runtime: AbilityBuffs preserves the three separate raw records and independently publishes the currently selected movement scale.
stats.test: MovementBuffProjectsTheSelectedStanceWithoutStackingChannels measures .45/.12/.12, and stock PR868 confirms its add, active records and matching removals. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/868#issuecomment-7087749583

consumer.source: The shipped effect has separate normal, Sneak and Invisibility movement components.
consumer.runtime: AbilityBuffs and Stealth recompute owner/observer speed from the active stance rather than reusing the normal run channel under stealth.
consumer.test: Native PR868 reports normal, Spy Sneak, and Belt travel factors 1.43/1.108/1.123 against the respective stance baselines and decodes the exact .12 stealth field. Exiting stance restores the normal channel. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/868#issuecomment-7087749583

behavior-tests.source: The retained Hyper-Speed record sets normal +45, Sneak/Invisibility +12, all 600 s. Expected cost 40 IS. The active effect is self-only.
